denial_letter:
NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of Notice: June 14, 2021
Member: [REDACTED]
Claim: Emergency department visit, date of service May 30, 2021
Reason Code: CO-A1

We have completed our review of the above claim. Benefits are not
available for this service. Section 7.2(a) of your Certificate of
Coverage provides that the plan does not cover services rendered in a
hospital emergency department. The charges submitted are therefore the
member's responsibility.

You may request an internal appeal within 180 days of this notice.

sub_claims.critique_notes: critique rejected: The finding states that the sub-claim is 'mixed,' but the evidence provided does not clearly support this conclusion. Specifically, Section 7.2(a) explicitly excludes coverage for services rendered in a hospital emergency department, and Section 7.2(b) provides an exception only under certain conditions (emergency medical condition as defined). Without clear evidence that the policyholder's situation meets the definition of 'Emergency Medical Condition,' the sub-claim should be denied.
sub_claims.draft_rationale: The evidence shows that Section 7.2(a) of the policy excludes coverage for services rendered in a hospital emergency department (p-7-2-a). However, Section 7.2(b) provides an exception to this exclusion, stating that the exclusion does not apply to emergency services required to evaluate or stabilize an emergency medical condition as defined in Section 1.9 (p-7-2-b). Since the definition of 'Emergency Medical Condition' is provided in Section 1.9 (p-1-9), and there is no evidence indicating that the policyholder's situation does not meet this definition, the sub-claim is mixed.

evidence.text:
Exclusions. This plan does not provide benefits for services rendered
in a hospital emergency department.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, the exclusion in Section 7.2(a) does not
apply to emergency services required to evaluate or stabilize an
emergency medical condition, as that term is defined in Section 1.9.

Emergency Medical Condition means a medical condition manifesting
itself by acute symptoms of sufficient severity that a prudent
layperson would reasonably expect the absence of immediate medical
attention to result in serious jeopardy to health.

Appeals. You may request an internal appeal of an adverse benefit
determination within one hundred eighty days of receiving notice.
